title: Zesty Venezuelan Quinoa Mousse
description: A savory, bouncy quinoa mousse with a caramelized sugar sauce and tempered chocolate, perfect for an energizing low-carb meal.
instructions: Rinse quinoa under cold water until water runs clear.
In a saucepan, bring water to a boil, add quinoa, reduce heat, simmer covered 15 minutes or until liquid absorbed.
Transfer cooked quinoa to a dry bowl, let cool slightly.
Melt butter in a small saucepan over low heat, add erythritol, stir until syrupy and lightly caramelized, about 2 minutes.
Remove from heat, whisk in coconut milk, a pinch of salt, and vanilla, then cool to room temperature.
In a microwave or double boiler, melt chopped dark chocolate until smooth, then stir into the cooled coconut mixture to temper.
Fold the chocolate coconut mixture into the warm quinoa until evenly incorporated and the mixture becomes thick and bouncy.
Spoon the mousse into pre-warmed talavera plates, smoothing the surface.
Garnish with lime zest and a drizzle of the caramelized sauce.
Chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving.
